en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy seaside beach scene. Elegantly dressed men, women, and children in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and play along the shoreline. In the background are seaside resort buildings and beach huts/strandkorbs along a sandy beach, backed by a wooded hill. A small boat lies on the sand in the foreground. The scene is labeled with red printed text in German at the bottom left and right.
